lies.text: Not a single peso changed hands. We ran a clean campaign.
lies.reaction: Envelopes with voters' names on them.

lies.text: Nobody was ever paid for a vote. Voters love us for free.
Our polls prove everyone is behind us. The people have spoken.
lies.reaction: A number with no method is only a slogan.

intro: The voters love us. Ask anyone. Anyone I have already asked.
